_comment: Which SWARM network THIS BUILD is for. Written by scripts/set-build-profile.mjs from SWARM_NETWORK_PROFILE, the same input that decides the release manifest's network_profile and which zebrad is fetched, so the two cannot disagree.
_why: A build ships every network definition it carries, and until now nothing inside the
packaged app recorded which one it was BUILT for. The app read its stored settings,
found networkProfile=swarm-testnet left over from an earlier install (or the hard-coded
default on a fresh one), and a mainnet installer came up on the testnet saying
'SwarmTestnet - engineering testnet' with no way to change it. See docs/NETWORK-PROFILES.md.
